story_type: elderly man stranded by a flood, soldiers carry him to a high water truck, then buy his groceries
hook: Floodwater all around his home, and his food was running out.
narration: Floodwater surrounded his home, and he was running out of food.
This was Titusville, Florida, on November twenty third, during a flooding crisis.
Florida Army National Guard soldiers drove through the high water to answer the rescue call.
High water trucks sit up on huge tires, so they can push through water that would stall a car.
The soldiers carried the elderly man out through the floodwater.
Then they lifted him into the back of the truck.
[short pause] And then they made one more stop.
outcome: The soldiers took him to a local grocery store and bought his groceries with their own money.
title: Soldiers carried him out of a flood
description:
Florida Army National Guard soldiers carried an elderly man through floodwater to a high water vehicle in Titusville, Florida, on Nov. 23, 2026, then took him to a grocery store and bought his groceries with their own money.
